author: CobolDotNet (working name)
name: COBOL Screen App
description: A COBOL program with a SCREEN SECTION. Builds a DOS-style console version, a Windows version, or both from the same source.

ScreenMode.description: How the program's screens are shown. You can change this later in the project file.

choices.description: Builds two programs from one source: NAME.exe (text screen) and NAME-Win.exe (window). Only controls with a DOS-screen equivalent can be used.
A text-screen program, like the COBOL systems of the 1980s.
A window program. Allows any Windows control, but there is no DOS-style version.
